Delete buttons in the toolbar can be told apart again.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Each delete button has its own icon.** The same cross stood for Delete Links: Disabled, failed, finished, offline and extracted, so several of them side by side in the toolbar looked alike. They now show a ban sign, a crossed circle, a ticked circle, a struck-through cloud and a zip file, in the same line style as the rest of the toolbar. [@Kayn2106](https://github.com/Kayn2106) reported it in [jdownloader #70](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jdownloader/issues/70).
